propositions: ~200 lines of production logic in reconcile-bridge-canary.yml run-blocks (staleness classification, alert-ticket lifecycle state machines) are untestable and unlintable by ruff, posing defect risk.
Classification and alert-lifecycle logic must be extracted to scripts/canary_bridge.py with unit tests covering api-error/no-success/stale/fresh states and open/comment/close transitions.
Two CAS push loops (commit-reconciler-events-back in reconcile-bridge.yml and flush-unpushed-changes in canary) must remain in YAML byte-identical and tested verbatim as documented exceptions.

Error handling disposition must be preserved per step: alert writes fail loud (non-zero exit); dedup finds degrade to not-found on failure; binding-drift fsck exit-1-with-valid-JSON is drift signal not error; DRY_RUN env gates both YAML and Python subcommand writes as defense-in-depth.

Anti-rot tests must pin canary wiring (workflow parses, steps invoke canonical Python entry points with expected env/args) and guard against logic-bearing run-blocks reappearing outside allowlisted flush loop.
